program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(true, !is_b@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j, !is_c@i & !is_bos@j | !is_bos@j & h1_1@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(!is_c@i & h2_1@i & !is_b@j | h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j, true)
accept = !is_a & !is_b & is_c & !h2_1 & !h3_1 | !is_a & !is_b & is_c & !h1_1 & !h2_1 & !h3_1

output accept
